3111013.findings: Bulbous milk jug with honey and cream streaked drip glaze, red-brown drip from rim, glazed base with pooled amber/red glaze, kiln stilt marks and a scored grinding mark. No incised signature or stamp on base (cropped and checked); only a handwritten paper inventory sticker on the side. Style is like interwar Australian art pottery or Tasmanian studio ware (e.g. John Campbell type) but nothing supports an attribution.
3111013.condition: Glaze runs and stilt scars on base from firing, no chips or cracks visible in photos.
3111013.reason: Unmarked drip-glaze jug; possible Australian pottery but no mark to support a maker, low value as is.
3111013.marks_read: none on base; paper stock sticker only

3111016.findings: Pair of seated spaniel figures with brown ears and tails, collars with lockets, decorated with black Willow pattern transfer. This is a modern decorative reproduction, not period Staffordshire pottery; no base photo.
3111016.reason: Modern Staffordshire-style reproduction dogs with transfer decoration.

3111037.findings: Four graduated green-glazed pottery canisters with knob lids. No marks visible; generic modern kitchenware.
3111037.condition: Some glaze specks/marks, lids present, no chips seen.
3111037.reason: Generic unmarked green glazed canister set.

3111134.findings: Tall baluster floor vase with printed and overpainted famille-rose style birds and peonies in reserves, typical late 20th century Chinese export decorative vase. No base photo, no reign mark seen.
3111134.condition: No damage visible from the two front views.
3111134.reason: Modern Chinese export decorative floor vase, low resale.

3111183.findings: Dial reads SEIKO 5, AUTOMATIC 21 JEWELS, day-date window. Gold-tone cushion case with silver sunburst dial and applied baton markers, circa late 1960s to early 1970s (likely 6119 calibre). Fitted with later tan leather strap. Caseback not shown so reference and serial not confirmed.
3111183.condition: Dial clean, crystal with light wear, gold plating on case shows some wear; strap is a later replacement. Running status unknown.
3111183.reason: Vintage Seiko 5 automatic 21 jewel day-date in gold tone, steady collector demand.

interest.note: Vintage Seiko 5 automatic 21 jewel day-date, gold-tone case, c. 1970, probably 6119 calibre; caseback not pictured.
